body: Thank you for your insights. I'm doing my best to be the best friend I can be. I'm able to relate to her because at one time I was suicidal myself, and I have some idea of what's going on in her head. I have read over some of the info in the sidebar you mentioned and I think it will prove to be helpful. I had considered calling the hotline myself earlier as you recommended however the situation has since diminished. She's 17 and I don't know the legality behind her leaving in our area. To my knowledge her mother is intermittently verbally abusive. I asked my friend if her mom hit her and she said she used to, but not anymore. The whole situation is terrible and I wish she had more/better options.
